title: Global expand/collapse semantics and screenreader announcement debounce
creator: Maya Chen
description: Audit and standardize expand/collapse interaction patterns across the Console (dashboards, rollout variant panels, cost card details). Focus areas: consistent use of aria-expanded/aria-controls, visible focus affordances for keyboard users, predictable announcement behavior for screenreaders when content collapses/expands during rapid interactions (e.g., time-range scrubbing, variant toggles). Identify a debounce/configurable delay strategy for aria-live assertions to avoid repeated noisy announcements while preserving timely feedback in single-action flows. Ensure text replacements and localized label length expansion do not break layout or hide focusable controls.
acceptance_criteria: All expand/collapse components use aria-expanded and aria-controls correctly and reference unique IDs

When users rapidly toggle or interact with controls that change live regions (e.g., timeline scrub, mass expand), announcements are debounced to a configurable interval (default 350ms) with no loss of the final state announcement
Keyboard focus never gets lost when panels open/close; tab order is preserved and roving focus patterns documented
Localized strings (checked for en, fr, de, ja, ar) do not clip or overlap important controls at typical translation expansions; UI adjusts to multi-line labels without hiding affordances
WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and focus visibility requirements met for expanded header and control states
Prototype and a11y test scripts added to the console QA harness; manual screenreader walkthrough passes on NVDA and VoiceOver with the new debounce behavior
notes: 2026-03-01: Ticket created after triage of multiple console a11y findings during rollout UX audit.
2026-03-03: Spike completed — measured mean toggle frequency in timeline scrub sessions ~4 toggles/sec; debounce of 250-400ms considered.

2026-03-05: Design decision: use polite aria-live for non-critical status lines and explicit single-state announcements for final states after debounce; document override for assertive where immediate feedback is required (e.g., destructive actions).
2026-03-07: Engineering suggested exposing debounce interval via data-attribute for component-level tuning; agreed, added as acceptance criterion.
2026-03-09: I18n review: Arabic translations cause header buttons to expand to 2 lines in cost cards; proposed layout fallback uses stacked label + control in narrow widths.

2026-03-11: QA walkthrough with NVDA revealed duplicate announcement when aria-expanded state and aria-live both fire; resolved by moving aria-live to a separate summarizing region and suppressing duplicate live updates when aria-expanded event occurs within debounce window.
2026-03-12: PR submitted for design tokens and component documentation; awaiting eng review (ENG-57421 dependency).
